notes.title: Demo/Pre-release v0.10.0 is LIVE
notes.notes: [p]Hi [b]Consonance Players,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]v0.10.0 includes the following changes:[/p][list][*][p]Options can now be accessed from the Title Page.[/p][/*][*][p]Tips now show in the Level Select and Levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Changes for Level 2-4: Cables (pre-release version only) to make it less ambiguous.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]For any feedback and bug reports, please visit the Consonance Community Hub.[/p][p]Thank you and have a great day.[/p][p][/p][h3]James Filomar[/h3][p](Developer)[/p]

notes.title: Demo/Pre-release v0.9.1 is LIVE - Timer Bug Fix
notes.notes: [p]Hi [b]Consonance Players,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This patch is to fix a bug where the timer in the levels increments slowly in some machines.[/p][p][/p][p]Unfortunately, your previous games' recorded times can no longer be corrected. If you wish to reset all previous games' recorded times, you may do so by going to [b]Options > Reset All Data[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]I apologize for any inconvenience.[/p][p][/p][p]For any feedback and bug reports, please visit the Consonance Community Hub.[/p][p]Thank you and have a great day.[/p][p][/p][h3]James Filomar[/h3][p](Developer)[/p]

notes.title: Demo v0.9.0 is LIVE - Casual Mode Update
notes.notes: [p]Hi [b]Consonance Players[/b],[/p][p][/p][p]Hope you are enjoying the Demo. I'm excited to announce that Demo v0.9.0 is now LIVE.[/p][p]This update contains the Casual Mode, a special mode where puzzle animations are slowed down for a more relaxed experience.[/p][p][/p][h3]Changelog:[/h3][list][*][p]Casual Mode - a special mode where puzzle animations are slowed down[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Next Level" button on completion of a level[/p][/*][*][p]Some levels' animations were slowed down[/p][/*][*][p]Minor animation changes in some levels[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]For any feedback and bug reports, please visit the Consonance Community Hub.[/p][p]Thank you and have a great day.[/p][p][/p][h3]James Filomar[/h3][p](Developer)[/p]
